title: A Twisty Movement
statementMd:
*A dragon symbolizes wisdom, power and wealth. On Lunar New Year's Day, people model a dragon with bamboo strips and clothes, raise them with rods, and hold the rods high and low to resemble a flying dragon.*

A performer holding the rod low is represented by a $1$, while one holding it high is represented by a $2$. Thus, the line of performers can be represented by a sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$.

Little Tommy is among them. He would like to choose an interval $[*l*, *r*]$ ($1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$), then reverse $*a*_{*l*}, *a*_{*l* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*r*}$ so that the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence of the new sequence is maximum.

A non-decreasing subsequence is a sequence of indices $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*k*}$, such that $*p*_{1} < *p*_{2} < ... < *p*_{*k*}$ and $*a*_{*p*_{1}} ≤ *a*_{*p*_{2}} ≤ ... ≤ *a*_{*p*_{*k*}}$. The length of the subsequence is $*k*$.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000)$, denoting the length of the original sequence.

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers, describing the original sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 2, *i* = 1, 2, ..., *n*)$.

## Output

Print a single integer, which means the maximum possible length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence of the new sequence.

## Note

In the first example, after reversing $[2, 3]$, the array will become $[1, 1, 2, 2]$, where the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence is $4$.

In the second example, after reversing $[3, 7]$, the array will become $[1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1]$, where the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence is $9$.
statementZhMd:
*龙象征着智慧、力量和财富。在农历新年的第一天，人们用竹条和衣服制作龙，用杆子将它们举起，并让杆子高低起伏，模仿飞龙的姿态。*

手持杆子较低的表演者用 $1$ 表示，手持杆子较高的表演者用 $2$ 表示。因此，表演者队列可以表示为一个序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。

小 Tommy 也是其中的一员。他想选择一个区间 $[*l*, *r*]$（$1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$），然后反转 $*a*_{*l*}, *a*_{*l* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*r*}$，使得新序列的最长非递减子序列长度最大。

非递减子序列是一个下标序列 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*k*}$，满足 $*p*_{1} < *p*_{2} < ... < *p*_{*k*}$ 且 $*a*_{*p*_{1}} ≤ *a*_{*p*_{2}} ≤ ... ≤ *a*_{*p*_{*k*}}$。该子序列的长度为 $*k*$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$），表示原序列的长度。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数，表示原序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 2, *i* = 1, 2, ..., *n*$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示新序列的最长非递减子序列长度的最大可能值。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，反转区间 $[2, 3]$ 后，数组变为 $[1, 1, 2, 2]$，此时最长非递减子序列的长度为 $4$。

在第二个样例中，反转区间 $[3, 7]$ 后，数组变为 $[1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1]$，此时最长非递减子序列的长度为 $9$。
